sources.title: FDCP: Film Philippines Incentives 2026 Cycle 2 Now Open for Applications
sources.said: The FPO supports international film and audiovisual projects through two key incentives, the Film Location Incentive Program (FLIP) and the International Co-Production Fund (ICOF). FLIP provides a 20% cash rebate of up to ₱25 million ($424,000) for eligible international projects in partnership with Filipino audiovisual service providers, while projects that prominently showcase Filipino culture and creativity may also qualify for a 5% cultural bonus, increasing total rebate to ₱30 million ($508,000).
